During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], a '''Rebel smuggler''' was present in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Glastro]] on [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]] when the [[Bimm/Legends|Bimm]] merchant [[Glah Ubooki]] was selling prototype weapons and technology from a crashed [[Unidentified Imperial R&D vessel|Imperial R&D vessel]]. The smuggler, realizing the value of the items, paid Ubooki a large sum for the find.<ref name="GUSWI" />
